items.text: Scanning schedule... You have a match with Tom. What is your plan for Saturday?
I am going to play football with Tom.
Good evening. Are you ready to order? What would you like?
Oh, I will have the hamburger.
Your poster says you perform at the school concert this Friday. What is your plan?
I am going to play the guitar at the school concert.
The teacher asks for a volunteer to clean the blackboard. What do you say?
Your appointment card shows Tuesday at four. What are you going to do?
I am going to see the dentist on Tuesday.
It starts raining hard. Your friend offers an umbrella. What do you say?
Your study wall says tomorrow morning you review Unit Three. What is your plan?
I am going to review Unit three in the morning reading.
Your friend drops an ice cream cone. You decide to share yours. What do you say?
I will share my ice cream with you.
